name: FLAT IRON — STRAIGHT (TEMPLATE)
_note_top: FIRST: link this flow to your real Flat Iron Master Assembly via the 'Link to Master Assembly' dropdown (linkedAssemblyId is intentionally blank — the assembly's DOC id differs per database, so a hardcoded one imports as UNLINKED). Shape-only preset: fabEndStyle + fabProjection are blank on purpose — Vision supplies end style + projection per line. One flow covers wall/ceiling/inside because each bracket option carries its own geometryMap (show selected, hide others), which replaces the old static hiddenClusters. Fill every PLACEHOLDER-* with your real M2C-INV part id (styleOptions) or the real mesh names from the .glb (geometryMap). The importer drops these _note keys.

steps.title: Pole / Rod Material
steps._note: Material SWAP — pick Wood vs Steel. Delete these placeholders and check the two REAL pole pins (wood-pole + steel-pole); each one's geometry then shows that pole and hides the other. It's a STYLE_SWAP (not dimensions) so it can swap geometry. hideQty=true (material has no quantity).

steps.title: Pole Length & Finish
steps._note: Finish grid + length. Comes AFTER the material swap; no geometry here (the material step already chose the pole).

steps.title: Mount
steps._note: Tag-driven Mount selector — options auto-fill from the assembly's Location tags (Wall/Ceiling/Inside); picking one hides every end cluster of the OTHER locations. No part/data/geometry wiring. 'mountPosition' = '' means the whole mount; for asymmetric ends split into two Mount steps with mountPosition 'LEFT' and 'RIGHT'. Check the box in the step builder; it needs no Part Handling.

steps.title: End Treatment
steps._note: OPTIONAL (required=false) — the ALTERNATIVE to an end-arm bracket: a job has either an end arm (the End Bracket step) OR a mitered/bent rod (a fab FEE, set as the option's price). Skip this whole step for the end-arm path — since unchosen geometry is hidden, the finial/miter/bend parts simply won't show. FINIAL = a physical end cap (real pin); RETURN_MITER / RETURN_BEND = fee options (no part, put the charge in price); FLUSH = nothing. optIds match Vision's endStyle so Push pre-fills it.

steps.title: Left End Bracket
steps._note: ALL mounts as options on ONE step. Picking one shows its bracket (Left) and hides the others via geometryMap. THIS is what lets a single flow handle wall + ceiling + inside. Vision pre-fills it from the left bracket you chose (matched by part id).

steps.title: Right End Bracket
steps._note: Separate from Left so the two ends can differ (e.g. left return, right passing-with-endcap). If your jobs are always symmetric you can delete this step and reuse Left for both ends.

steps.title: Wall Plate (Backplate)
steps._note: The wall plates, as their OWN step (not combined with the bracket). These line up 1:1 with Vision's bpOrientation (54254/53061 = Vertical, 53060/53062 = Horizontal). Vision pre-fills from the backplate you chose.

steps.title: Center Passing Bracket

styleOptions.partName: Flat Iron Wall Passing Bracket Arm
Flat Iron Ceiling Passing Bracket Arm

steps._note: isCenterClone=true -> the picked center bracket is cloned 'qty' times and spaced down the pole in the live render. Only ONE center node needs to exist in the .glb (at the middle). Qty + part come straight from Vision.

steps.title: Rings
steps._note: Ring finish + qty. No geometryMap needed (rings don't swap geometry).

steps.title: Splice
steps._note: For long / joined poles. Qty from Vision.

steps.title: Cut / Splice Fee
steps._note: Flat per-cut/splice fee. Set basePrice to your charge.
